value.rationale: Pairwise idempotent commutation measures semilattice-compatible structure in classical Catalan monoids, distinct from i-Catalan monoids in which all idempotents commute. The theorem classifies compatibility of every pair and gives all-size closed enumeration, natural probability decay, and an exact per-idempotent centralizer computation. The recurrence is independently known as OEIS A007070, but the claimed value is the natural semigroup interpretation and exact per-element compatibility relation, not rediscovery of that sequence.
